text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gulf Air confirms one of its Boeing 767s and a Romanian airliner came close to colliding over New Delhi on Sunday.
- United Nations Development Programme to provide more financial and technical assistance to projects in Gulf Arab states.
- Income from tourism could double in Bahrain by the year 2005 if the right investment decisions are made, says an expert.
- New initiatives are launched to bolster industrial investments in the country.
- Gulf water subject to pollution from oil tankers sunk in the region during the Gulf War.
- Bahrain Islamic Bank board of directors announces a 5.371 million dinar profit for depositors and a 1.15 million dinar for shareholders for the past 12 months.
- Bahrain plans to host an Egyptian products exhibition on October 13.
